summary: Tested new Super Admin billing/usage feature (per-org signup-anchored usage tracking, manual placeholder pricing tier, manual Stripe fields, trial tracking, CSV export, filters/sort, 12-cycle history). Backend: 15/15 pytest passing. Frontend: full end-to-end UI flow verified via Playwright (toolbar filters, sort, drawer form with all data-testids present, tier auto-fill Growth->30 confirmed, save + reload persistence confirmed via screenshot, past_due/past-date red highlighting confirmed, CSV download not verified only because escape-key didn't close drawer on second attempt — no functional issue).
action_items: End-to-end recording->audio_duration_seconds capture on a NEW meeting was NOT exercised by this pass (requires the recording+transcription pipeline to run in preview). Backend schema check confirms meetings.audio_duration_seconds exists and GET /orgs returns current_period_hours/cumulative_hours=0 for all orgs (matches intentional no-backfill design). Main agent should record ONE short meeting manually to fully close the loop.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /orgs/{id}/billing silently coerces invalid pricing_tier/stripe_subscription_status to NULL (verified in test_invalid_tier_silently_nulled). Consider returning 400 instead so misconfigured clients notice, rather than wiping the field.
SuperAdminDashboard.js is 1411 lines — approaching the 700-line soft limit; consider splitting TierBadge/StripeStatusBadge/UsageBar + Billing drawer into their own files.

handleSaveBilling sends included_hours_monthly=null when input is blank, but router only applies the update if data.included_hours_monthly is not None — so a blanked-out value cannot be cleared server-side (this is the documented, accepted limitation; leaving as-is per instructions).
list_orgs runs one extra query for ALL meetings with audio_duration IS NOT NULL and groups in-memory — fine now, but for growth consider a per-org rollup table when meeting counts get large.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable UI (recording->duration loop not exercised)
